title: Best of Hokkaido: Northern Japan
alt: Lavender fields below the hills at Furano, Hokkaido
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Sapporo
stops.subtitle: Sapporo to Lake Toya and Otaru
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel in Sapporo, close to the subway

activities.name: Sapporo sightseeing tour
activities.description: The clock tower, Odori park, the old government building and the Hokkaido shrine, with a stop at the beer museum.

activities.name: Noboribetsu and Lake Toya
activities.description: The steaming Jigokudani hell valley at Noboribetsu, then the caldera lake at Toya with Mount Usu above it.

activities.name: Jozankei, Otaru and Shiroi Koibito park
activities.match: Jozankei Onsen, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park Day Tour
activities.description: The hot spring valley at Jozankei, the canal and glass workshops of Otaru, and the chocolate factory at Shiroi Koibito park.

program.name: Sapporo
program.description: Four nights in the island capital with a city tour and two full days out, to the hell valley and lake, and to Otaru's canal.

stops.name: Asahikawa
stops.subtitle: Asahikawa to Furano and Daisetsuzan
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Straightforward hotel opposite Asahikawa station

activities.name: Asahikawa with Hokuryu sunflower village
activities.match: Asahikawa Sightseeing Tour with Hokuryu Sunflower Village
activities.description: The city sights and then the sunflower fields at Hokuryu, two million flowers in bloom across the hillside in season.

activities.name: Furano and Biei day tour
activities.description: The lavender farms of Furano and the patchwork hills of Biei, with the blue pond at Shirogane on the way back.

activities.name: Daisetsuzan national park
activities.description: Hokkaido's roof: the ropeway up Asahidake, the alpine trails and the gorge at Sounkyo with its waterfalls.

program.name: Asahikawa
program.description: Four nights inland with the sunflower fields, the lavender and patchwork hills of Furano and Biei, and a day in Daisetsuzan national park.

1: Arrival at New Chitose Airport and private transfer to Sapporo
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: dinner in the Susukino lanes
2: Breakfast, then a guided day around Sapporo
The clock tower, Odori park and the old government building
The Hokkaido shrine in its woodland
A stop at the Sapporo beer museum
3: Lake Toya, a caldera lake with Mount Usu above it
Back in Sapporo in the evening
4: Breakfast, then the hot spring valley at Jozankei
Otaru's canal, warehouses and glass workshops
5: Breakfast and check out, then inland to Asahikawa
Rest of the day free in town
Optional: the Asahiyama zoo for the afternoon
6: Breakfast, then a guided day around Asahikawa
The city sights and local markets
The sunflower fields at Hokuryu village
Back at the hotel in the evening
7: The lavender farms and flower fields
The blue pond at Shirogane on the way back
8: Breakfast, then east into Daisetsuzan national park
The ropeway up Asahidake and the alpine trails
Back in Asahikawa for the evening
9: Check out and private transfer to the airport
Flight home or on to Tokyo

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Hokkaido is the Japan nobody expects: lavender hills, volcanic lakes and space to breathe. Two bases, six guided days.
expert.tip: Go between July and early September for the lavender and the sunflowers, or February if you want the snow festival instead. Both are worth the trip.

summary: Nine days in northern Japan: four nights in Sapporo with a city tour, the Noboribetsu hell valley with Lake Toya and Otaru's canal, then four in Asahikawa for the sunflower fields, the lavender hills of Furano and Biei, and Daisetsuzan national park.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Sapporo sightseeing tour; Noboribetsu and Lake Toya tour; Jozankei, Otaru and Shiroi Koibito park day tour; Asahikawa tour with Hokuryu sunflower village; Furano and Biei day tour; Daisetsuzan national park tour.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
